title: 101 Dalmatians
blurb: The 1961 animated film and its sequel, a 1990s live-action pair with Glenn Close, and Cruella, an origin story for the villain.

groups.title: The 1990s live-action films
groups.note: A remake with Glenn Close as Cruella, and its sequel.

groups.title: Cruella
groups.note: A live-action origin story for the villain.

note: Cruella is a standalone origin story. Its end-credits scene sets up the dalmatians story, but its 1970s setting doesn't fit neatly with any of the other films.
